figures.caption: Figure 2: Fabrication steps of the X-ray gratings by combining deep reactive ion etching of silicon and atomic layer deposition of iridium. After the photolithography step (a), the grating pattern is transferred into the chromium hard mask, (b), used during the silicon deep reactive ion etching, (c). The final atomic layer deposition step, (d), coats the silicon trenches with a conformal layer of iridium.
